## 📋 Summary
This PR adds helpers to generate Schema.org JSON-LD structured data (`Product` and `BreadcrumbList`) for catalogue product pages. Overall structure is clean and follows Schema.org standards, but there is a logic bug in `brandName` resolution when suppliers do not have URLs.

---

## 🔍 Findings

### 🟠 High

**`hard_product_jsonld.ts:26`**
`brandName` filters suppliers based on whether `s.url` is an HTTP(S) URL (`product.suppliers.filter((s) => /^https?:\/\//i.test(s.url ?? ""))`), even though only `s.name` is consumed for the brand.

Since `url` is optional on `Supplier` (`url?: string`), any product whose suppliers do not specify a website URL will be filtered out entirely, causing `brandName` to erroneously fall back to `product.categoryLabel`.

**Actionable Fix:**
Check for a valid supplier `name` rather than filtering on `url`:

```typescript
function brandName(product: Product): string {
  const supplier = product.suppliers.find((s) => Boolean(s.name?.trim()));
  return supplier ? supplier.name : product.categoryLabel;
}
```

---

## ✅ Positives
- Clean JSON-LD construction following Schema.org specifications for `Product` and `BreadcrumbList`.
- Correct 1-based indexing for breadcrumb `position` items.
